title: game/equipment.json
description: The slot groups gear is worn in (I03a, inventory-plan 3.4): one row per group, each with its slots, the item tags it accepts, whether one of a kind is allowed, and whether the worn items give their stats. Loaded by EquipmentData (Vocaterra.Game.Core); EquipmentValidator checks the values and the items (group ids unique keys, slots with unique names, every item with a `wear` has a slot of that kind in a group that accepts one of its tags, and a stack limit of 1). The order of the groups and of their slots is part of the bundle: commands and the state digest carry indexes. Equipment code never names a group.

generated_by.description: Who or what wrote the file (hand-authored).

bagSlots.description: The inventory's slots with no bag worn (I03b): the hotbar's 10 and the rows under it (default 30). A worn bag item adds its `capacity` (items.json); the hotbar is the first 10 slots.

groups.description: The groups in order (the order commands and the digest index).

id.description: The group's stable key (clothing, armour, accessories...). Code never names it.

layer.description: Where the avatar draws the group: 1 under, 2 over, 3 looks only. Left out for a group that is not a drawn layer.

slots.description: Named slots (head, body, legs, feet). An item's `wear` must equal the slot's name.

labels.description: The Spanish noun of each named slot (a key of `slots`), which the panel names the slot with.

count.description: How many identical slots (accessories 3, the off-hand 1, the backpack 1).

wear.description: The wear kind of every counted slot (accessory, offhand, back).

label.description: The Spanish noun of the counted slots; left out when the lexicon has no word yet.

heading.description: The Spanish noun that heads the group's column in the equipment panel (I04b: ropa, armadura, apariencia); only for a group with a `layer`. A fourth layer brings its own heading.

accepts.description: The item tags the group takes: an item with any of them fits.

noDuplicates.description: Whether one item kind may be worn only once in the group (the accessories).

statsApply.description: Whether the worn items give their stats (false for the cosmetic layer).
